scope: Each generator plus its distinct matched real references; test split only

dalle3.decision_rule: score > threshold predicts label 1; equality predicts label 0

methodology.auroc: positive-negative concordance; score ties receive half credit
methodology.average_precision: sum of recall increments times precision at distinct score thresholds; ties grouped
methodology.missing_class_policy: AUROC, AP and balanced accuracy are null unless both classes are present
methodology.ece: positive-class calibration error, 10 equal-width probability bins; [lower, upper), final bin includes 1
methodology.nll: binary negative log likelihood, natural logarithm
methodology.threshold_fitting: none; select and freeze using validation data before test evaluation
